ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark base pigmentation; high-contrast white mottling concentrated at the left and right distal tips and scattered along the interior trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a symmetric angular convergence of the medial lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; notable large-scale jagged indentations on the right lobe's outer margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily concave curve trajectory along the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-intensity pixel spots (rosettes) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint linear white pixel disruptions visible on the dark surface of the right lobe medial to the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue void (indentation) on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip; heavy scarring/pigmentation loss at both fluke tips.
